summary: AECOM filed an 8-K to announce its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.31 per share, part of its ongoing quarterly dividend program. The dividend is payable July 17, 2026 to holders of record July 1, 2026. No premium, price per share, or transaction terms are applicable as this is a routine dividend declaration. There are no advisors, recommendations, or special structural conditions. This is a standard recurring distribution not constituting a special situation.
